representation.localProgramRef: Document-local source-heading ordinal, not a canonical database program ID or approved taxonomy decision.
representation.printedCardNumber: Literal source token; null means the source leaves the card-number column blank.
representation.printedTeamColumn: Literal column contents, including anomalies such as WR; not a validated school identity.
representation.literalMarker: Literal 1st Bowman where printed; null preserves a blank source cell and does not mean not-rookie.
representation.literalSourceRow: Four literal cells separated by tabs: number, name, team column, marker. Spacing inside each cell is collapsed; spelling, case and punctuation retained.
representation.bboxPoints: [left, top, right, bottom] in PDF points, top-left origin; page dimensions recorded separately. Encoded heading glyphs can extend beyond the visible clipping region.
representation.sourceLineOrdinal: One-based nonempty PDF glyph line ordinal on its page, counting headings.
representation.pageRowOrdinal: One-based roster row ordinal on its page, excluding headings.
representation.sectionHeadings: BASE and AUTOGRAPH are preserved as literal heading occurrences; no inferred category for subsequent sections.

CJ Donaldson Jr. in the base roster versus CJ Donaldson in II autograph is retained.
Cooper Dejean, Jayden De laura and FLORIDA ATLANTIC® retain exact case. Team trademark symbols or their absence are preserved throughout.

Nine of the ten short-print rows have a different printed player name from the base row bearing the same numeric card number. No correction or cross-heading join is made. The tenth, 41 Harold Perkins, agrees on name.

Words such as AUTOGRAPH, PARALLEL, VARIATION and SHORT PRINT are literal source-heading text. They do not supply printing IDs, finish, odds, serial denominator, edition, channel/format or card-to-printing applicability in this transcription.
